fb_text:
Half the crews in this industry are Spanish-first. Yours might be too.

The old way: your guy calls it in from the job site, in Spanish. You're mid-stop, catching half of it, scribbling the rest on a notepad you hope you can read tonight. Details get lost between the truck and the log.

The new way: he voice-notes it — in his own words, in his own language. FieldNotes turns it into a clean English service log. What got done, what's broken, what to bring next time. Nothing lost in translation because there's no translation to do.

I run a commercial plant service company — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. Every stop my crew works gets logged the same way: they talk, FieldNotes writes it down.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
